snippet.title: Fun with monsters in Half-Life | XDM
snippet.description:
Test map: monsters.

Headcrabs can eat roaches, gibs, ... grenades :)
Bullsquids eat crabs and some other stuff.
Barnacles eat almost everything. Sometimes they regret it... for milliseconds :)

Also, you can see entity manipulation mode in action (select+move mode).
In XDM, you can do many interesting things with mouse. It helps, for example, to quickly place entities such as weapons, ammo and monsters in real time (not shown in this video).

Download:
http://www.moddb.com/mods/xdm
